forum.title: Problems running relocatable ai model
forum.best_answer_content:
Hi @rphii,

The way to install and initialize the model seems correct. However, I note that LL\_ATON\_Set\_User\_Input\_Buffer() is used to set the address of the input buffer in the ai\_run fct. As for the output, the ll\_aton\_reloc\_set\_input() fct should be also used.

Have a good day.

jm
